observations: Taskall_paths requires organ.nii.gz and lesion.nii.gz. Formatter checks exact0/1 and full shape only if input exists, internalorgan optional; missing masks are incomplete, not malformed. Affine is not checked.

Dice uses >0.5; shape mismatch returns0error. Scorer lesionmean includes valid GTpositive pairs only, organmean valid available pairs. Aggregate recomputes organmean across nonnullpercase including shapeerror0, scales metrics by lesionoutputcompletion, computes0.5organ+0.5lesion and0.5workflow+0.5clinical. Medal uses unscaledmeanlesion.
